task_spec: Implement lower_bound(arr, x): the index of the FIRST element >= x in an ascending-sorted list (i.e. the leftmost position where x could be inserted to keep it sorted); return len(arr) if every element is < x.

bugs.description: The comparison `arr[mid] <= x` computes UPPER bound, not lower bound: it advances past elements equal to x, so it returns the index of the first element STRICTLY GREATER than x. For lower_bound([1,2,2,3], 2) it returns 3 instead of the correct 1. The condition must be `arr[mid] < x`.

provenance.note: subtle bug requiring reasoning/domain knowledge to catch
